newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska to cooperate with Coca-Cola.
newsitem.headline: Skanska to cooperate with Coca-Cola.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska AB said on Tuesday Coca-Cola Co had chosen it as its strategic partner for building projects.
"Skanska has signed a global cooperation agreement with The Coca-Cola Company in Atlanta, United States to develop building projects for Coca-Cola," Skanska said in a statement.
Skanska said it would be finding cheaper and faster solutions for Coca-Cola's production plants and distribution channels.
It gave no financial details about the deal.

Coca-Cola has signed similar contracts with other construction companies in the world, Skanska said. Its contract involved parts of central and eastern Europe, the former Soviet Union and North America.
